summary: Warmup prefetch credit posted to parent cost center and missing from customer subaccount after private->hosted fallback during reserved capacity rollover
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that scheduled 'warmup prefetch' credits (automatic cache warmup credits generated when reserved capacity rolls over) were not applied to their subaccount invoice. Instead a negative line item with identical amount was posted to the parent organization (BrightHealth Holding) on the same billing run.

Impact:
- Customer saw an unexplained charge on their final invoice for 2026-02-28 cycle (-$5,120 warmup credit reversal applied to parent instead of subaccount).
- Customer requests correction and a provisional credit while engineering investigates.
- Affects month-end accounting for a healthcare-regulated customer using Private deployment with hosted fallback.

Environment:
- Private deployment (vpc) with hosted fallback enabled for region us-east during reserved-capacity rollover window.
- Billing run: 2026-02-28 23:00 UTC
- Postback reconciler version: billing-v1.19.3
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer has reserved capacity rollover scheduled nightly.
2) At 2026-02-28T22:58:03Z private node experienced transient VPN flapping and request routing triggered hosted fallback for prefetch job.
3) Warmup prefetch job completed, postback emitted from hosted fallback path with org_tag 'parent:brighthealth' instead of 'sub:brighthealth-ai' due to tag-translation race during rollout.
4) Billing reconciler ingested postback and allocated credit to parent ledger.
logs:
Postback payload snippets (sanitized):
- timestamp: 2026-02-28T22:58:11Z
- event: warmup_prefetch_complete
- tokens: 51200
- claimed_credit_units: 5.12
- org_tag: parent:brighthealth  <-- incorrect

Reconciler trace-id: trace-bill-827413
Invoice line on parent org: INV-2026-02-28-PARENT-001 (negative line item: -$5,120 warmup credit)
Subaccount invoice shows no corresponding credit line.
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: tag-translation service (org-tag-translate) returned parent tag for postback when private-to-hosted fallback occurred in short window after reserved rollover.
- Reconciler logic uses the postback org_tag to map credits; no additional verification when postback source is 'hosted-fallback'.
- We reproduced locally by simulating a fallback postback during a tag-translation cache miss; mapping went to parent.
- Incident appears limited to jobs where (a) private node fell back in same minute as rollover, and (b) org-tag-translate returned stale mapping due to race with recent org hierarchy change (customer recently created subaccount).
- Related change: billing-v1.19.3 introduced small performance optimization in tag cache TTL (PR #2831).
customer_messages: We pulled our month-end close and noticed a missing credit on the subaccount invoice and a negative line on the holding company invoice. This breaks our internal reconciliation and requires an immediate provisional credit.
Customer asked for estimated timeline for correction and for temporary balance hold so autopay does not fail.
comments: Aisha Patel (Support): Opened ticket after customer email. Collected invoice screenshots, added to ticket.
Rachel Kim (Billing eng): Triage - reproducing locally against billing-v1.19.3, creating minimal repro harness.
Marco Diaz (SRE): Observed VPN flapping at 2026-02-28T22:57:50Z on private gateway gw-prod-us-east-4; likely triggered fallback. See slack #incidents thread.

Rachel Kim: Confirmed repro and created PR to add cross-check: verify postback org_tag against submitter API key metadata when source == hosted-fallback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/2837
Support: Customer provided signed confirmation that BrightHealth Holding can receive cross-charges but customer expects credit on subaccount; support proposed provisional credit while fix rolls out.
resolution_summary:
Workaround: Issued provisional credit of $5,120 to BrightHealth AI subaccount and flagged parent invoice for adjustment. Root cause: race condition between org-tag-translate cache TTL and private->hosted fallback path that led to an incorrect org_tag on warmup prefetch postback.
Fixes implemented:
- Short-term: reconciler now checks postback submitter key metadata when source == hosted-fallback to avoid solely trusting org_tag (hotfix deployed 2026-03-13).
- Medium-term: rolled back TAG cache TTL optimization and added unit/integration tests for fallback path mapping (PRs #2837, #2842).
- Billing team scheduled audit job to scan Feb billing runs for other occurrences and to create adjustment batches where applicable.
Follow-ups: Billing to run reconciliation sweep and issue corrected invoices or credit memos; engineering to monitor for 72 hours post-deploy.
